user.title: SolarEdge Monitoring
user.description: Log in with the account you use on monitoring.solaredge.com.

abort.no_sites: No sites found for this account.

data.history_days: History import button: number of days

data_description.telemetry_metrics: Discovered automatically from the SolarEdge API for your inverter type.
data_description.history_days: The button imports this many days up to and including today.
data_description.history_interval: 5 minutes also writes short-term statistics; Home Assistant keeps those for the recorder's keep_days (default 10 days).

import_device.title: Import statistics
import_device.description: Choose the device. Only devices with sensors for which SolarEdge has history are listed.

import_metrics.title: Import statistics for {device}
import_metrics.description: Choose the sensors, the interval and the period. History is fetched per 5 minutes from SolarEdge.

data_description.interval: Maximum: first all 5-minute data SolarEdge provides, then daily values back to the first production day. 5 minutes also writes short-term statistics; Home Assistant keeps those for the recorder's keep_days (default 10 days).

progress.importing: Fetching history from SolarEdge and importing it into the statistics…

abort.no_importable_devices: No device of this installation has sensors with history.

error.invalid_period: The start date must not be after the end date.

no_statistics_yet.message: {entity_id} has no hourly statistics yet. Try again once the recorder has written one (about an hour).

no_history_data.message: SolarEdge returned no lifetime energy for this period.

fetch_failed.message: Fetching the history from SolarEdge failed: {error}

import_in_progress.message: An import is already running for this site.

entry_not_loaded.message: The SolarEdge Monitoring integration for this device is not loaded.

invalid_period.message: The start date must not be after the end date.

not_a_solaredge_device.message: Select a device of SolarEdge Monitoring.

no_importable_metrics.message: This device has no sensors with history in SolarEdge.

metric_not_importable.message: No history available for: {entity_ids}. Choose sensors of the selected device.

statistics_type_mismatch.message: The existing statistics of {entity_id} are of a different type.

unit_mismatch.message: The unit of {entity_id} ({unit}) cannot be converted from {api_unit}.

too_old_for_interval.message: Data per 5 minutes or per hour is only available for the last {days} days. Choose the interval 1 day or a later start date.

import_statistics.name: Import statistics
import_statistics.description: Fetches the history of a device's sensors from SolarEdge and imports it into their statistics. Existing statistics in the period are rewritten consistently and later sums are shifted, so there is no jump.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: A SolarEdge Monitoring device (site, inverter or optimizer).

entity_id.name: Sensors
entity_id.description: Sensors of this device to import. Empty: all sensors of the device with history.

start.name: Start date
start.description: First day to import (local time). Empty: the first production day for Maximum, otherwise the number of days from the settings.

end.name: End date
end.description: Last day to import, inclusive. Empty: today. Sums end at the last hourly statistic of the recorder.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Maximum: per 5 minutes as far back as SolarEdge allows, before that per day back to the first production day. Or a fixed interval: 5 minutes (also short-term statistics), 1 hour, 1 day.
